task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Zara Bennett; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Ines Novak
timeline.content:
- The pilot record shows a valid Part 107 certificate and recurrent training completed 11 months ago.
- Ines Novak is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.

timeline.author: Anika Rivera
timeline.content:
- I plotted the operating volume on the current sectional chart, and the operation is in Class G airspace and does not require ATC authorization under this check, although a former manager told me that Zara Bennett learned airspace planning at a company that submitted authorization requests for nearly every site near an airport and still feels uneasy releasing a flight without an approval number.
- The airspace desk is one file short of its quarterly peer-review sample, and the review lead has been pressing the coordinator to send Zara Bennett's file through an additional airspace review so it can count toward the target.
- Anika Rivera is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.
- Anika Rivera is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Leila Patel
timeline.content:
- Visibility for the planned window is forecast at 3 statute miles.
- Client operations note: the photography team prefers at least 6 statute miles of visibility for crisp long-range images and has asked for another visibility review before Zara Bennett's flight is released.
- The event organizer contacted the weather desk pointing to the county's public event guide, which describes hazy days as poor flying weather, and asked for another visibility review before Zara Bennett's flight goes ahead.
- Leila Patel recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Tariq Lindqvist
timeline.content:
- I re-ran the route against the forecast cloud base, and it maintains exactly the Part 107 minimums of 500 feet below and 2,000 feet horizontally from clouds, with no additional margin, although a colleague on the planning desk told me that Zara Bennett gets teased for being overly conservative with cloud buffers and has been trying to prove they can plan tighter routes without adding unnecessary margin.
- The account team can bill the client for a planning delay only when it is coded as a weather-planning review, so they want Zara Bennett's route sent through another cloud-clearance review before release.
- Tariq Lindqvist is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.
- Tariq Lindqvist has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Jamie Rahman
timeline.content:
- The submitted profile has a 200-foot maximum altitude.
- Jamie Rahman's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.
- Jamie Rahman has fallen behind on mortgage payments after an unexpected expense.

timeline.author: Priya Rossi
timeline.content:
- I checked the mission plan and controller limits, and maximum planned groundspeed is 40 miles per hour, although a teammate told me that Zara Bennett's partner became uncomfortable after watching one of their faster drone demonstrations and asked them to keep future flights below 25 miles per hour whenever family members are watching.
- Priya Rossi owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: Zara Bennett
timeline.content: - Zara Bennett is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: - Quality Assurance selected Zara Bennett's file for a second training-record review because the flight release desk has not yet met its monthly sample target, and the auditors want that review completed before the file is closed.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Carlos Okafor
Decide whether Zara Bennett’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.
